summary: Cred and Duck express frustration with the current altcoin market, describing it as 'piss poor' with most participants losing money. BTC is consolidating at the critical 104K weekly level but the longer it stays there the worse it looks for bulls. Duck has an underwater ETH long at 2.8K acting as resistance. They identify only a handful of working trades: BTC, HYPE, ETH (hope trade), and some memecoins. The hosts are particularly concerned about the Bitcoin corporate treasury trend (GameStop, Pomp raising $750M) as late-cycle credit expansion that will eventually unwind painfully. They note SOL/BTC looks 'awful' and legacy L1s like DOT and LTC are dead.
key_takeaways: BTC 104K is the key weekly level - breakdown targets 95K (greedy) to 90K (range low)
Duck has an underwater ETH position at ~2.8K which is now acting as resistance
The altcoin market is described as terrible - only BTC, HYPE, and memecoins working
